availableMessage: FinLedge Desktop 1.3.0 is available. Install it from the release page to get the latest features.
requiredMessage: This version of FinLedge Desktop is no longer supported. Please install the latest release from GitHub.
releaseNotes: New: Transfer money between Bank and Cash directly inside Personal Expenses.
New: Transfer records can now be edited after they are created.
New: Edit and Delete your own manually entered records from the View Dashboard.
New: Gift added as an expense and income category in Personal Expenses.
Removed: Investment, SIP, and Share Market no longer appear in Personal Expenses (use the Share Portfolio module instead).
Fixed: Cash Flow income was showing as negative when a Bank to Cash transfer was made.
Fixed: Combined view was showing two rows for the same transfer — now shows only one.
